subject: ScaleCloud co-host invite: invite copy, segment lists, tracking & RSVP cadence
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-06-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: ScaleCloud co-host invite: draft + target segments

Team,

We're on for a co-hosted webinar with ScaleCloud on July 15 (US-friendly time). Need to finalize invite copy, target lists, tracking links, and the RSVP reminder cadence this week so we can hand off to DevRel for landing page and the ops team for sends.

Asks:
- Marissa: can you propose 3 subject lines and one short + one long body (developer and manager personas)? Keep subject char < 60.
- Vivek & Olga: segment lists — recommend dedupe rules and target thresholds (active customers, engaged trials, platform leads).
- I'll draft UTMs and HubSpot campaign; please review.

Attachments: scalecloud_invite_targeting_v1.xlsx (segmentation + sample HubSpot lists)

Timing: want final copy and list sign-off by EOD Thu (2025-06-05).

Thanks,
Karthik
Head of Developer Marketing, Redwood Inference
[attachment: scalecloud_invite_targeting_v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-06-02T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ScaleCloud co-host invite: draft + target segments

Karthik —

Thanks, quick turnaround from me below. Two persona bodies and three subject lines (short). I also attached an editable invite copy and a tracking-link matrix so ops can map UTMs per send.

Subject line options (test these in this order):
1) "Build faster inference pipelines with ScaleCloud + Redwood"
2) "How ScaleCloud & Redwood cut inference cost by 3x"
3) "Join our live demo: production LLM inference at scale"

Short body (developer):
Hi {first_name},
Join engineers from ScaleCloud and Redwood for a 30-minute demo showing how to serve LLMs reliably with predictable latency. We'll cover batching, KV caching, and a hands-on walkthrough of a live inference pipeline.
RSVP now — limited seats.

Long body (manager/architect):
Hello {first_name},
If your team is evaluating inference stack options, this session covers the operational levers that lower token cost while keeping latency SLOs. We’ll discuss routing policies, quantization trade-offs, and real-world throughput numbers. Stick around for a short AMA with our engineering leads.
Reserve your spot — seats capped for a focused cohort.

Reminder cadence (recommended):
- Initial invite (T = 0)
- Reminder 1: 5 days before (T = -5)
- Reminder 2: 1 day before (T = -1)
- Day-of: 2 hours before (T = -0.083)

UTM / tracking notes (see matrix):
- utm_source=scalecloud_partner
- utm_campaign=scalecloud_webinar_jul15
- utm_medium=email

Attachments: invite_copy_v2.docx, invite_tracking_matrix.csv

Marissa
Sr. Demand Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference
[attachment: invite_copy_v2.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-06-03T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ScaleCloud co-host invite: draft + target segments

Quick notes on segmentation/dedupe: 
- Primary targets: platform engineers (job title), infra architects, trial accounts with > 3k tokens/month in last 30 days.
- Exclude: customers invited to similar sessions in last 60 days; unsubscribe list; low-engagement (<1 open in 90d).
- Dedupe rule: priority to existing customers (customer flag) > engaged trials > outbound prospects.
- Send windows: PST mornings (9–11am) for devs, 12–2pm PST for managers.

I'll run the dedupe script and upload final lists to the shared Drive by EOD Wed.

Vivek
Director, Growth Ops
[attachment: none]

From: Sarah Lin <sarah@scalecloud.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: partner-ops@scalecloud.com
Date: 2025-06-04T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ScaleCloud co-host invite: draft + target segments

Hi Karthik —

Love the copy, and ScaleCloud is excited to co-promote. A couple quick asks from our side:
- Can we get a VIP list (10-15) for priority outreach? We'll drop those to our AE team.
- Speaker slot: can one of your engineers do a 10-minute co-demo + 10-minute AMA? Our product lead will take the other half.
- Please share a one-page run-of-show and the finalized UTM mapping so our ops team can coordinate.

I'm looping in partner-ops@scalecloud.com to coordinate the calendar. For speaker scheduling, here's our team Calendly: https://calendly.com/scalecloud/partner-sessions

Thanks — talk tomorrow?
Sarah Lin
Head of Partnerships, ScaleCloud
[signature: Sarah Lin | sarah@scalecloud.com | +1 415-555-0199]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>

Sarah / team —

Great, thank you. Next steps and owner map below: 
- VIP list (10–15): Marissa & Vivek to compile candidate names from account execs and active trials; deliverable: spreadsheet in Drive. (owner: Vivek, due: 2025-06-06 EOD)
- Speaker schedule: Sarah — we'll use your Calendly; I'll ask Eng to pick two 15-min blocks (owner: Karthik; due: 2025-06-07).
- Run-of-show (one-pager): attached (run_of_show_v1.pdf). Please confirm content; aim to lock by EOD 6/7.
- UTMs / tracking: final matrix uploaded to Drive and mapped to HubSpot campaign 'scalecloud_webinar_jul15'. (owner: Marissa)

Shared assets: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ABCxyz-invite-assets
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/DEAL-4982

Marissa — please push the editable invite to the Drive folder and mark which subject line you recommend for the initial send. Vivek — please upload the deduped lists. Sarah — once we have the VIP names I'll share a short outreach note we can both use.
